T-347: ASHMOOR — the era-2 first slice, a distant flat OFFSET REGION at world (-420,0) (far WEST corner, r>330 so TerrainField.height()==0, LOD-culled + fog-hidden from Era-1's origin village, maximally clear of the crypt's (+420,0)). Open/shared region (instance_id 0): an era is a world, players in Ashmoor see each other (ashmoor-direction.md S1). Buildings front the High Street cobble strip (splat: terrain_splat.gdshader ashmoor_* masks) from the SOUTH (terrace row at world +Z=8; per world-conventions -Z=north/+Z=south); the arrival plaza + rift monolith sit to the NORTH at world -Z (this prop at z=-10, arrival gaslamps z=-8), all at flat grade y=0. T-418 note: the terrace door facades face -Z=NORTH across the cobble strip toward this arrival — an earlier props.json comment had the compass inverted and the terraces exported doors to +Z (backs to the strip); T-418 rotated the seven prop_ashmoor_* buildings rot_deg=180 to face the arrival. THIS prop = the ARRIVAL monolith (the T-344 Vault prop reused, ashmoor-direction.md S2; T-407 upgraded the shared GLB to the carved split menhir with the emissive tear, baked flagstone base and socket_rift shimmer/motes/night-glow): the rift's far end — crossing the crypt Vault monolith teleports here; the rift_gate EXIT (dev return) trigger sits at this point.

T-348/T-418: the era-2 soot-brick KIT block replaces the T-347 4-unit terrace repetition. Seven walk-in door_module archetypes at the era-2 bar (true coursed-brick scan + real metal iron/brass, normal maps everywhere, socket_gaslamp) front the High Street cobble strip (ASHMOOR_COBBLE_RECT centre z=0) from the SOUTH: the buildings sit at y=8 (world +Z, SOUTH per world-conventions) and T-418 rotated them rot_deg=180 so the door_module FRONTS (T-405 signage, socket_gaslamp brackets, lit shop windows) face -Z=NORTH across the cobble strip toward the arrival plaza + rift (z=-8..-10). Before T-418 the compass was inverted (rot_deg=0 exported doors to +Z, so the strip/arrival saw the terrace BACKS). West->east, party-wall abutting: CORNER SHOP (its return shopfront — now the +X return after the flip — faces the west cross-street), WAREHOUSE, the GREY GULL speakeasy (unmarked door; interior sockets socket_sigil + socket_cellar_stair seed the Gull Cellars, ashmoor-direction S5), the CONSTABULARY (socket_service desk sergeant + two barred cells), then the SHOPFRONT/ROWHOUSE/NARROW terrace variants. Door world-z after the flip: 3.25-4.5; the y=2.5 high_street street lamps + pavement (T-406, moved to the front by T-418) sit north of the fronts on the cobble side. FOLLOW-UP (T-406 soot re-key): the sun-keyed soot was baked onto the local +Y/back faces (world -Z=north/shaded at rot_deg=0); after the 180 flip those sooty backs face +Z=SOUTH (sunny) — a GLB regen must re-key soot to the new shaded north FRONT-adjacent faces, or accept dark backs. Arrival fronts are clean (no soot on the storefront face).
